visualReview.method: Opened real PNG screenshots and decoded sequential frames from the recorded actual Chromium run; no synthetic animation replay.
observations: Full-screen harbor retained; three moving Node ships with container-bound directed teal measured flow traces between actual observed endpoint anchors.
Low/high recording frames show changed ship pose and moving measured traces; high-load overlay explicitly reports bounded rendered flows against total flows.
Actual 3D-arrow click opens opaque Soft UI flow detail; TCP transport/protocol, FORWARDED, direction, observation timestamps and10-second window visible.
Keyboard Enter on network facility flow-list row opens the same endpoint UID pair detail. Flow group IDs differ between the two actions; exact group equality is not asserted.
Stopped producer final frame and render diagnostics both show0/0 measured flows after12seconds; provider remains live, so no stale current-flow illusion.
limitations: Single selected 3D/semantic pair is cross-Node. Same-Node distinct-Pod actual observations are asserted by UID and visible flow input, not a separately opened Same-Node detail panel.

Screenshot at high density has long scene status caption extending beyond the right viewport edge; detailed list has total/omitted counters and readable records. Minor visual polish limitation retained; no product edit in this evidence job.
Selected flow detail endpoints below fold are verified by actual modal text in actions; initial screenshot shows upper portion only.
No provider-loss/DNS/energy/FPS/CPU/long-soak conclusion from this finite visual recording.
